chunk_method.title: Chunk Method
chunk_method.naïve: General (Uses visual detection model to split continuous text into segments)
chunk_method.laws: Legal Documents (DOCX, PDF, TXT formats. Uses text features to detect split points)
chunk_method.manual: Manual (PDF format, uses chapter titles for chunking)
chunk_method.presentation: Presentation (PDF, PPTX. Each page is treated as a chunk)
chunk_method.qa: Q&A (Excel, CSV/txt with two columns: question and answer)
chunk_method.table: Table (Excel, CSV. First row must be column headers with meaningful terms)
